title: The Green Wood and the Salt Flats
subtitle: A biome by tag, and a biome by id
description: Two biome tasks, the two spellings. The first names `#minecraft:is_forest`, a tag, so standing in any forest counts — a `#` in front of a biome means the whole tag. The second names `minecraft:desert` exactly, so only the desert does.
The dotted line into this node is `dash: dotted`, the finest of the six patterns.
